name: colour-wash
title: Colour wash
summary: Fills the layer with one colour at a time, moving through Colours.

name: bars
title: Bars
summary: Bands of colour move in Direction, one colour each from Colours.

name: plasma
title: Plasma
summary: A field of sine waves flows at Speed, coloured back and forth through Colours.

name: clouds
title: Clouds
summary: Soft clouds drift in Direction, thickest in the last of Colours; a good mask input.

name: fire
title: Fire
summary: Flames rise in Direction from the edge of the layer, hottest in the last of Colours.

name: butterfly
title: Butterfly
summary: Mirrored wings flow at Speed, banded back and forth through Colours.

name: spot
title: Spot
summary: A round spot of one colour at the layer's centre, or where an anchor puts it.

name: circles
title: Circles
summary: Balls of colour drift and bounce round the layer, melting together where they meet.

name: wave
title: Wave
summary: A line waves across the layer in Direction: a sine, a triangle or a square.

name: shockwave
title: Shockwave
summary: A front bursts out in Direction, fast then slowing, and fades as it goes.

name: lighthouse
title: Lighthouse
summary: Beams of colour turn round the layer, each fading behind as it passes; or stripes.

name: curtain
title: Curtain
summary: A pleated curtain parts from the middle as far as Open; bind Open to draw it.

name: single-strand
title: Chase
summary: Bands or comets of colour chase along every strand.

name: arch-chase
title: Arch chase
summary: The arches light one after another, each filling along its wire, then fading.

name: life
title: Life
summary: A cellular automaton lives along every strand, a generation at a time.

name: sparkle
title: Sparkle
summary: Single LEDs glint, each in its own colour and at its own time.

name: streaks
title: Streaks
summary: Lines of colour fall in Direction in lanes, each with a fading tail, or as swaying flakes.

name: ripple
title: Ripple
summary: Drops land at random spots and spread rings that fade as they grow.

name: lightning
title: Lightning
summary: A forked bolt strikes in Direction every few seconds and fades.

name: fireworks
title: Fireworks
summary: Shells burst into rings of sparks that sag and fade, each a colour from Colours.

name: tendril
title: Tendril
summary: Tendrils wander the layer, each trailing a body that tapers behind it.

name: spire-rise
title: Spire rise
summary: Colour climbs each spire behind a bright head, crowns the tip and lifts away, tower by tower.

name: garlands
title: Garlands
summary: Rows of swags drape across the layer one after another, then fade.

name: strobe
title: Strobe
summary: Flashes the layer at Speed, 2 a second by default; over 3 a second fails the flash check.

name: heartbeat
title: Heartbeat
summary: Colours swell out from the centre, lub-dub, every two beats of the look's tempo.

name: wash-breathe
title: Wash breathe
summary: The layer breathes from the low colour up through the body and back, each inhale rising from the ground.

name: shimmer
title: Shimmer
summary: Every LED glitters fast between the body colour and the highlight, like sequins in a spotlight.

name: rising-sweep
title: Rising sweep
summary: Bands of colour climb every surface like a tide of light, trading a base colour for a sweep colour.

name: depth-wave
title: Playa wave
summary: Colour rolls from the playa front to the back of the nave through a three-colour palette.

name: spire-helix
title: Tower helix
summary: Candy stripes spiral up round each tower and its spire, or round the layer's own centre, like xLights' Spirals.

name: pinwheel
title: Pinwheel
summary: Curved vanes of palette colour turn round the layer's centre from a glowing hub.

name: galaxy
title: Galaxy
summary: Spiral arms wheel round a bright core, accent near the heart and body colours at the rim.

name: rose-ripple
title: Rose ripple
summary: Rings of light spread in 3D from the rose window through the arches, towers and spires.

name: rose-chase
title: Rose chase
summary: Petals light in turn round the rose window like clock hands while rings breathe outward.

name: rose-bloom
title: Rose bloom
summary: The rose window opens ring by ring from its heart as far as Open; bind Open to draw it.

name: meteors
title: Meteors
summary: Shooting stars race along every arch, spire strand and canopy run, trailing fading tails.

name: marquee
title: Marquee
summary: Theatre-sign bulbs step along every strand in body and accent groups over the low colour.

name: aurora
title: Aurora
summary: Slow curtains of green and violet drift over a deep night-blue sky, drawn with fractal noise.

name: twinkle
title: Starfield
summary: Every LED a star with its own rhythm, glinting over a slowly shifting night sky.

name: snowflakes
title: Snowflakes
summary: Flakes drift down through the layer, swaying, and settle in a drift that builds, then melts.

name: snowstorm
title: Snowstorm
summary: Driven snow streaks across the layer on the wind, each flake trailing a tail through swirling gusts.

name: canopy-rain
title: Canopy rain
summary: Rain streaks down through the layer and beads along the canopy runs as it passes.

name: nave-procession
title: Nave procession
summary: Bands of candlelight walk from the playa front to the back of the nave, a step on every beat.

name: mirror
title: Mirror
summary: Folds the layer onto itself: left-right, front-back, up-down or along every strand.

name: kaleidoscope
title: Kaleidoscope
summary: Cuts the layer into turning, mirrored wedges round its centre.

name: radial-repeat
title: Radial repeat
summary: Repeats the layer in rings round its centre, moving outward.

name: mosaic
title: Mosaic
summary: Snaps the layer to blocks: tiles across the façade and runs of LEDs sharing a colour.

name: polar
title: Polar
summary: Turns the layer into a circle: across becomes the angle round the centre, up the distance from it.

name: anchor
title: Anchor
summary: Moves the centre to a group by tag: the rose, the nearest tower; or lines layers up on the whole rig.

name: rotate
title: Rotate
summary: Turns what is above it by an angle, or spins it, in the façade, from the side or in plan.

name: scroll
title: Scroll
summary: Slides the layer in Direction at Speed, wrapping round.

name: twist
title: Twist
summary: Swirls the layer round its centre and winds the towers into spirals.

name: turbulence
title: Turbulence
summary: Pushes what is above it around with slowly changing noise.

name: tint
title: Palette tint
summary: Recolours what is above it from Colours, keeping its light and shade.

name: gradient-map
title: Gradient map
summary: Recolours what is above it by brightness: dark parts the first Colours, bright parts the last.

name: hue-shift
title: Hue shift
summary: Turns colours round the colour wheel by place along Direction, and over time.

name: posterize
title: Posterize
summary: Rounds colours to a few flat steps.

name: invert
title: Invert
summary: Swaps light and dark, or turns each colour to its opposite hue.

name: mask
title: Mask
summary: Shows the chain only where its input source is bright.

name: threshold
title: Threshold
summary: Keeps only what is brighter than a level, so busy textures become crisp shapes.

name: blur
title: Blur
summary: Softens colour across neighbouring LEDs, along each strand or through space.

name: edge-fade
title: Edge fade
summary: Fades what is above it out toward one edge; move Position to wipe.

name: trails
title: Trails
summary: Leaves a fading afterglow behind whatever moves.

name: palette-drift
title: Palette drift
summary: Hues drift slowly round the colour wheel, spread up the layer and swirled by noise.

name: pinwheel-preset
title: Pinwheel
summary: Curved spokes of colour turn round the centre from a bright hub.

name: starfield
title: Starfield
summary: Stars glint over a dark, slowly moving sky.

name: meteors-preset
title: Meteors
summary: Comets race along every strand over a dark sky, each strand at its own pace.

name: curtain-preset
title: Curtain
summary: A pleated curtain opens, holds, closes and holds, over the first colour.
